text: {"label":"Cocaine Seeking, Self-Administration, and Abstinence","definition":"Studies of cocaine as a reinforcer, covering self-administration, relapse and resurgence of cocaine seeking, and impulsive choice in rats and monkeys, plus contingency management for abstinence in people with cocaine use disorder.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses specifically on cocaine, unlike stimulant effects on timing and schedule-induced behavior, smoking and general substance-abuse treatment, or behavioral pharmacology of medications as a discipline."}
